questions.q: We don't have an IT department – we ___ all our tech support to a small firm in Iași.
questions.explainRo: **Outsource** = a da o activitate unei firme externe.

questions.q: The bank still runs on a thirty-year-old ___ that only two programmers really understand.
questions.explainRo: **Legacy system** = un sistem vechi, moștenit, pe care firma încă îl folosește.

questions.q: Ana says: "I had my car washed yesterday." What does she mean?
options: Someone washed the car for her.
She is going to wash the car.
She had already washed the car.
questions.explainRo: **Have + obiect + V3** înseamnă că altcineva a făcut treaba pentru tine.

questions.q: Can we ___ (personaliza) the dashboard with our company's colours and logo?
questions.explainRo: **Customise** = a personaliza, a adapta ceva după nevoile tale.

questions.q: Our new neighbour is said ___ five languages.
questions.explainRo: Pentru ceva valabil în prezent folosim **is said + to + verb**: is said to speak.

questions.audio: It's believed that the castle is haunted.
answers: It's believed that the castle is haunted.
It is believed that the castle is haunted.
questions.ro: Se crede că în castel bântuie fantome.
questions.explainRo: **It is believed that…** = „se crede că…”, o formă impersonală și obiectivă.

questions.q: Have you ever had your website ___ (test) by an external company?
questions.explainRo: În structura **have + obiect + V3** verbul stă la participiu: had your website tested.

options: The restaurant is said that it has the best pizza in town.
It is said the restaurant to have the best pizza in town.
The restaurant says to have the best pizza in town.
The restaurant is said to have the best pizza in town.
questions.explainRo: Corect este **subiect + is said + to + verb**; nu amestecăm această structură cu „that”.

questions.ro: Mâine îmi verific dinții la dentist.
questions.explainRo: **Get + obiect + V3**: dentistul face controlul, nu tu; „get” e varianta mai informală a lui „have”.

questions.q: The vendor is believed ___ (lose) two of its biggest clients last year.
questions.explainRo: Pentru o acțiune din trecut folosim **to have + V3** după is believed.

questions.ro: Se anunță că vechiul depozit urmează să se închidă.
questions.explainRo: Pentru ceva aflat în desfășurare acum folosim **is reported to be + -ing**.

questions.ro: Se spune că vecinii noștri își vând casa.
answers: Our neighbours are said to be selling their house.
Our neighbors are said to be selling their house.
It is said that our neighbours are selling their house.
It is said that our neighbors are selling their house.
It's said that our neighbours are selling their house.
It's said that our neighbors are selling their house.
Our neighbours are said to be selling their home.
It is said that our neighbours are selling their home.
It's said that our neighbours are selling their home.
questions.explainRo: „Se spune că…” = **It is said that…** sau **subiect + is said to be + -ing** pentru ceva în desfășurare acum.
